from django.views.generic.edit import FormView
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.http import HttpResponse
from tablib import Dataset
from .models import Timesheet, Department
from .forms import ExportTimesheetForm
from .resources import TimesheetResource

class ExportDepartmentTimesheetsView(LoginRequiredMixin, FormView):
    form_class = ExportTimesheetForm
    template_name = 'timesheets/export.html'

    def form_valid(self, form):
        dept_id = form.cleaned_data['department_id']
        file_format = form.cleaned_data['file_format']
        
        dept = Department.objects.filter(id=dept_id).first()
        if not dept or not (dept.managers.filter(id=self.request.user.id).exists() or self.request.user.is_staff):
            raise PermissionDenied("You are not authorized to export timesheets for this department.")

        queryset = Timesheet.objects.filter(department=dept)
        resource = TimesheetResource()
        dataset = resource.export(queryset)
        export_data = getattr(dataset, file_format)

        response = HttpResponse(export_data, content_type=f'text/{file_format}')
        response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="timesheets_dept_{dept_id}.{file_format}"'
        return response
